generation.description: 你试听后选定的主方案；直接使用神经网络识别到的 beat/downbeat 峰值，不构造 BPM 网格。
generation.difficultyDescription: 全程保持操作，随音乐强度递进

repeatConsistency.policy: Core rows are canonical per familyId + durationClass; auxiliary rows require occurrence consensus, except labelled climax overlays.

melodyBurst.policy: Real detector peaks are preserved; a unique climax template keeps the surrounding core anchors on one lane.

generation.musicalStructureTimingPolicy: Beat and downbeat times are copied from Beat This! detector peaks. All internal bar, phrase, and section boundaries reference those downbeats; only the final open bar may end at the decoded song duration. no BPM grid, snapping, interpolation, or event-time quantization is used.
generation.timingPolicy: All algorithm event times are detector peaks in seconds. No BPM grid, snapping, or gap filling is used.
